course.title: AI Native Engineer
course.short_description: Agents write the code. You learn to direct them across the entire stack, with 200+ concepts, a team of three and a startup of your own.
course.description: A six-month internship that trains you to direct AI across the whole stack rather than to type code. You learn how every layer works - web, backend, data, cloud, AI - well enough to brief an agent precisely and to judge whether what came back is correct. You work in a group of three, build your own startup from the first week, and ship it. Daily live sessions, online or at the Nashik offices. Everything runs on free tiers and open-source models.
prerequisites: A laptop and a stable internet connection
Willingness to work in a group of three
learning_outcomes: Direct AI agents to build, ship and operate real software across the whole stack
Follow any system-design or AI-product conversation and place every term on an architecture diagram
Write specifications and briefs precise enough to get correct output the first time
Verify AI output and catch the five ways it goes wrong
Ship a working product with authentication, data, payments and at least one AI feature
Run the version control, testing and deployment practices a real team depends on
target_audience: Engineering students in any branch and any year
Beginners who have never written code but want to build real products
Anyone who wants to work as an engineer in the AI era
course.meta_title: AI Native Engineer - CTOschool Internship Program 2026
course.meta_description: Become an AI Native Engineer: 200+ concepts across full stack, ML/DL and agentic AI, daily live sessions, groups of three and your own startup built with AI.
course.meta_keywords: AI native engineer, AI internship, agentic AI, full stack with AI, Claude Code, RAG, internship Nashik

tier_plan.name: Sprint
tier_plan.short_description: The full concept map, your team, and a shipped MVP.

tier_plan.name: Build
tier_plan.short_description: Everything in Sprint, plus shipped apps, deeper ML and agents, and marketing automation.

tier_plan.name: Company
tier_plan.short_description: Everything in Build, plus real users, growth loops, distribution and revenue.

modules.title: Orientation: How Software Works and How to Direct AI
modules.description: The four boxes every app is built from, what is inside the machine, and the Director's Loop you will use for the next six months.

modules.title: Your Team, Your Startup and Version Control
modules.description: Split product, tech and growth across three people, find a problem worth solving, write the PRD, and set up the version control a team and its agents depend on.

modules.title: The Web from the Ground Up
modules.description: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, HTTP and frameworks - enough to read any web page's structure and direct precise changes to it.

modules.title: Design: UX, UI and Accessibility
modules.description: What good looks like, how to direct design rather than generate it, and how to build interfaces everyone can actually use.

modules.title: Backend, Data, Auth and Payments
modules.description: APIs, schemas, queries, authentication, authorization and taking money without ever charging twice.

modules.title: Scale and Reliability
modules.description: Why apps fall over at lunch rush, and the caching, rate limiting, scaling and reliability patterns that stop it.

modules.title: Cloud, Linux, DevOps and Testing
modules.description: Where software actually runs, how it gets there safely, and the tests and debugging habits that let an agent verify its own work.

modules.title: Security, Observability and Analytics
modules.description: The OWASP basics, the AI-specific risks, and how to know what your app and your users are actually doing.

modules.title: Mobile and Multi-Platform
modules.description: Native, cross-platform and PWA - how to choose, and how to make your product installable.

modules.title: AI Foundations: ML, Deep Learning and LLMs
modules.description: What is actually inside the AI you use daily - from training and embeddings to context windows, model choice and token economics.

modules.title: Building with AI: RAG, Agents and Harnesses
modules.description: Grounding, RAG, evals, agents, MCP and harnesses - and how to make a repository an agent can verify its own work in.

modules.title: Ship Your MVP: Build Checkpoints
modules.description: The review gates your product passes through across the Sprint, from PRD and architecture to ten real users and a technical demo.

modules.title: Ship Web and Mobile Apps for Real
modules.description: Past the MVP: app stores, push notifications, offline sync, crash reporting and performance on real devices.

modules.title: Production Engineering: Architecture, Testing and Operations
modules.description: The depth behind the Sprint overviews - GraphQL and gRPC in practice, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, load testing and incident response.

modules.title: Deeper ML, Deep Learning and Multi-Agent Systems
modules.description: Training loops, fine-tuning, quantization, evals that catch regressions, multi-agent orchestration and LLMOps.

modules.title: Content Engine and Social Automation
modules.description: Distribution is the product's other half: SEO, a content engine that does not sound like AI, and automated multi-channel posting.

modules.title: Users, Behaviour Analytics and Growth Loops
modules.description: Getting real users, instrumenting what they do, finding the real leak, and running growth loops and experiments.

modules.title: Distribution, Revenue and Running the Company
modules.description: Positioning, pricing, billing, unit economics, AI cost margins, launch channels and the weekly operating review.

modules.title: Demo Day: Ship and Defend
modules.description: The architecture walkthrough, the ten what-if questions, live debugging under questioning, and the operational handover.

modules.title: Frontier and Hardware Electives
modules.description: Blockchain, quantum, IoT and robotics - literacy rather than mastery, as a Company-track bonus.
